item.title: Mitigate now (update): Multiple Critical NGINX Vulnerabilities
item.description:
Multiple Critical NGINX: exploited from day 0 · partial fix · CCB: patch immediately

First step: Install the latest update for Multiple Critical NGINX, and check the vendor advisory: reports say part of it is not fixed yet. Restrict who can reach it until it is.

The Centre for Cybersecurity Belgium (CCB) warns about this and advises to patch immediately. The CCB advisory lists the affected versions and the fix.

Critical · Partial fix · CVE-2026-113425, CVE-2026-118899, CVE-2026-120967, CVE-2026-120993, CVE-2026-121810
